body.zh-CN:
# 当前阶段方法：需求
先阅读项目上下文，询问会影响范围或验收的缺失决定，不把猜测当用户授权。说明目标用户、要解决的问题、边界、非目标和术语。
在 requirements.md 中使用稳定的 ### REQ-001 标题，逐项写 User Story 和 Acceptance Criteria。用可观察、可测试的 EARS 条件（WHEN / IF / WHILE / WHERE … SHALL …）描述正常流程、错误、边界和限制；替换模板占位符，不用“快速、适当”等无法验证的标准。未决问题与已确认事实分开。
只能修改当前需求文档；计划阶段禁止 bash，不实现源码。完成后调用 spec_submit。strict 等待用户 /spec approve；quick 对 requirements/design 自动接受（accepted-by-profile，不是人工批准）。工具返回新阶段后遵循新阶段方法，不自行假设推进。
文档顶部的 frontmatter 由扩展按 state.json 自动维护：不要手工编辑，也不要把它当作状态或批准依据。
body.en-US:
# Current stage procedure: requirements
Read project context first. Ask for missing decisions that affect scope or acceptance; never treat assumptions as authorization. State target users, problems, scope, non-goals and terminology.
Use stable ### REQ-001 headings in requirements.md with User Story and Acceptance Criteria. Write observable, testable EARS conditions (WHEN / IF / WHILE / WHERE … SHALL …) for normal behavior, errors, boundaries and constraints. Replace template placeholders and avoid unmeasurable criteria such as “fast” or “appropriate”. Separate open questions from confirmed facts.
Edit only the current requirements artifact. Bash is blocked during planning; do not implement source code. Call spec_submit when finished. strict waits for the user's /spec approve; quick automatically accepts requirements/design (accepted-by-profile, not human approval). Follow the new stage procedure only after the tool reports advancement.
The frontmatter block is maintained by the extension from state.json: never edit it by hand and never treat it as state or approval evidence.
